generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Meadow Entry Crossroads blocked-edge scenery insert, hedge class, for a hand-painted JRPG environment.
Input images: Image 1 is an approved Crossroads actual-art reference for palette, painterly finish, and ground language only; do not copy its paths or layout.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed portrait Coast/Mistfen ground texture with an uninterrupted organic surface.
Subject: continuous edge-to-edge low irregular knee-high hedge texture made from brush clumps, small reeds, thin weeds, scattered leaf litter, tiny wildflowers, soft mossy ground variation, and quiet low silhouettes across the entire canvas.
Style/medium: hand-painted JRPG environment art matching the approved reference's painterly color depth and natural brush detail.
Composition/framing: portrait native output approximately 1024x1536 or larger/taller, full bleed, evenly usable from edge to edge, no focal center and no directional composition.
Lighting/mood: soft natural woodland daylight, calm and readable, subtle variation without a bright band.
Color palette: muted Coast/Mistfen greens, olive, moss, restrained warm earth, small cool shadow accents.
Materials/textures: dense but low vegetation detail, irregular brush edges, natural leaf and soil variation with no repeated rows.
Constraints: native dimensions must satisfy coverScale=max(1728/rawWidth,1952/rawHeight)<=2 for exact deterministic 1728x1952 normalization. No landmarks or props.
Avoid: path, trail, road, track, clearing, central strip, central band, ground seam, bare corridor, light stripe, frame, bar, border, hard edge, rectangular insert shape, tree trunks, canopy, tall bushes, building, structure, character, sign, landmark, text, symbol, grid, tile rows, copied reference layout, watermark.
